title: Unit 8 Quiz App — That's Really Interesting!
subtitle: Assessment after Unit 8 · the ExamView L4U8 quiz · 10 parts · 37 questions · 50 points · no right/wrong shown while answering

content: Match the seven hobby photos to what you hear on TR 8.1, and fill the collecting chart from TR 8.2.
Complete the video-game text with alone, avatar, compete, controller, cooperate and score.
Read 'Letterboxing' and 'Comic Books' and answer true/false and matching questions.
Write 3 to 4 sentences about a hobby you like, and answer the five speaking prompts from the picture.
language: Join two sentences with who: I have a grandmother who loves to cook.
Move the object and add to or for: My cousin sent a letter to me. I made a cake for them.
Put a scrambled sentence back in order, keeping who and to/for in the right place.
Give examples with for example and such as.
